conversationMessages.content: Use UTC for the schedule. Notion database_id: 1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef. Recent deal notes = deals updated in the last 7 days. Stalled = AI judgment from the notes content. Telegram chat_id: 123456789. No more questions please - generate the plan.

steps.title: Trigger weekly run (Friday 17:00 UTC)
steps.description: Use a schedule/cron trigger with a fixed cron expression to run the flow every Friday at 17:00 UTC.

steps.title: Query recent deals in Notion (last 7 days)
steps.description: Query the Notion database_id (1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef) for pages whose last_edited_time is within the last 7 days. Sort by last_edited_time descending so the digest highlights most recently updated deals first. If the Notion API filter cannot directly filter by last_edited_time via query, fall back to: (a) query by sorts + page_size, then (b) filter locally by last_edited_time >= cutoff.

steps.title: Extract deal fields and notes text from Notion properties
steps.description: From each returned page, extract: deal title (page title property), last_edited_time, URL, and your notes property (rich text/text). Normalize notes into plain text (join rich text fragments) and drop deals where notes are empty to avoid low-signal AI analysis.

steps.title: AI classification of stalled deals + next steps (per deal)
steps.description: For each deal (loop in handle), send the deal context (title, last edited time, notes text, optional URL) to the AI agent and request structured JSON output: { stalled: boolean, stall_reason: string, next_steps: string[], confidence: 'low'|'medium'|'high' }. Stalled determination is based on AI judgment from notes content. Collect per-deal assessments for digest assembly.

steps.title: Assemble the pipeline digest message
steps.description: Group results into sections such as: “Stalled deals (need attention)” and “Active deals (next steps)”. Include for each deal: name, last edited date, 1-line stall reason (if stalled), and 1–3 actionable next steps. Add a header with the date range (last 7 days) and totals (deals analyzed, stalled count). Format as Telegram HTML (safe tags only) and keep message length within Telegram limits (truncate or split into multiple messages if needed).

steps.title: Send digest to Telegram
steps.description: Send the digest to Telegram chat_id 123456789 using Telegram send_message with parse_mode = HTML. Optionally disable link previews to keep the digest compact.

plan.summary: Run every Friday at 17:00 UTC, pull deals from your Notion database edited in the last 7 days, use an AI agent to flag stalled deals and propose next steps from the notes, then send a formatted pipeline digest to your Telegram private chat.
